items.title: 更進新聞：OpenAI試推ChatGPT Wallet，代理付款須逐筆確認
items.summary: OpenAI開始在dots逐步推出ChatGPT Wallet，首階段面向持有合資格美國發行支付卡的成年美國ChatGPT Pro用戶。
highlights: 用戶每次付款前須核對商品及總額，再通過安全確認。
付款網絡以支付代碼替代實際卡資料。
items.why: 電商團隊可檢查現有結帳是否支援這類交易，以及客服能否辨識代理完成的訂單。
items.next_step: 與支付服務商核對交易識別、拒絕原因及退款流程，再安排測試。
items.detail: OpenAI表示，用戶先加卡，每次購買仍須核對商品、總額及所選卡片，並通過安全確認。付款網絡提供代碼，代理及商戶不會取得實際卡資料。商戶仍負責定價、履約和退貨。首階段透過dots逐步開放，電商團隊可用現有支付和客服流程評估相容性。可先向支付服務商了解代理交易被拒時會如何顯示。
items.title_en: Update: OpenAI starts ChatGPT Wallet rollout with per-purchase approval
items.summary_en: OpenAI began rolling out ChatGPT Wallet in dots to eligible adult US ChatGPT Pro subscribers with eligible US-issued cards.
highlights_en: Users review the items and total and complete a security check before each purchase.
The payment network substitutes a payment token for actual card details.
items.why_en: Commerce teams can check checkout compatibility and whether support staff can identify agent-assisted orders.
items.next_step_en: Check transaction identification, decline reasons and refunds with your payments provider before testing.
items.detail_en: OpenAI says users add a card and then review the items, total and selected card and pass a security check for each purchase. The network supplies a token so neither the agent nor the business receives actual card details. Merchants remain responsible for pricing, fulfilment and returns. The rollout starts in dots, giving merchants a specific flow to assess with their payments and service teams. Ask the payments provider how a declined agent-assisted transaction is displayed.

items.followup: 11月13日版報道ChatGPT商家中心。今次新增的是OpenAI在dots推出的逐筆確認付款功能。
items.followup_en: The November 13 edition covered Business Hub. The new development is purchase-by-purchase payment approval in dots.

items.title: Tiger Brokers新加坡戶外廣告試用三個AI代理，人員保留審批
items.summary: Adzymic披露一項已完成的實地試點，AI代理協助Tiger Brokers在新加坡規劃戶外投放和製作素材。
highlights: 試點在新加坡逾260塊數碼屏幕投放。
人員保留媒體計劃審批、素材檢查和上線安排。
items.why: 戶外媒體團隊可把版位規劃及素材尺寸調整分開測試，保留商業批准責任。
items.next_step: 挑一組版位，比對代理提出的屏幕清單、素材規格及實際可購庫存。
items.detail: 媒體方Stellar Ace、技術供應商Adzymic與Tiger Brokers在新加坡執行戶外廣告試點。據合作方披露，三個AI代理分工提出媒體計劃、審視庫存和製作適合不同屏幕的素材。Tiger Brokers審閱並批准計劃，媒體方再接受投放，相關團隊也檢查素材並安排正式上線。
items.title_en: Tiger Brokers tests three AI agents in Singapore outdoor ads with human approval
items.summary_en: Adzymic disclosed a completed live pilot in which AI agents helped Tiger Brokers plan outdoor media and prepare creative in Singapore.
highlights_en: The pilot ran on more than 260 digital screens in Singapore.
People retained media-plan approval, creative checks and launch operations.
items.why_en: Outdoor media teams can test inventory planning and creative resizing separately while keeping commercial approvals with staff.
items.next_step_en: Select one set of placements and check the proposed screens and specifications against available inventory.
items.detail_en: Stellar Ace, Adzymic and Tiger Brokers ran the Singapore outdoor advertising pilot. The participants say three agents proposed a media plan, assessed inventory and prepared creative for different screens. Tiger Brokers approved the plan before the media owner accepted the buy. Teams also checked creative and managed delivery.

items.title: 更進新聞：飛豬雙11旅遊促銷，已履約商品成交額按年增60%
items.summary: 新華財經引述飛豬指，雙11活動商品已履約成交總額按年增60%，交易用戶數增41%。
highlights: 促銷主打先購買、其後預約使用的旅遊套票。
數字只涵蓋飛豬平台活動商品及交易用戶。
items.why: 酒店和景點可把售出套票、成功預約及實際使用分開量度。
items.next_step: 按套票批次追蹤購買、預約、核銷及退款，找出最常中斷的一步。
items.detail: 飛豬公布的數字把活動商品已履約成交總額與交易用戶數分開，兩項指標均按年比較。平台促銷以預購後預約的旅遊套票為主。酒店團隊評估同類活動時，可分別追蹤預購、成功預約、實際使用和退款，並檢查熱門日期是否有足夠可預約房量。各批次採用同一觀察期，才便於比較核銷情況。
items.title_en: Update: Fliggy reports 60% growth in fulfilled Singles' Day travel promotion sales
items.summary_en: Xinhua Finance cited Fliggy reporting 60% year-on-year growth in gross merchandise value for fulfilled promotional products, and 41% growth in transacting users.
highlights_en: The promotion focused on prepaid travel packages that customers book later.
The figures cover Fliggy's promotional products and transacting users.
items.why_en: Hotels and attractions can measure package sales, bookings and actual usage separately.
items.next_step_en: Track purchases, bookings, redemptions and refunds by package cohort and identify the largest drop-off.
items.detail_en: Fliggy reported fulfilled promotional gross merchandise value and transacting users as separate year-on-year measures. Its promotion focused on travel packages bought in advance and booked later. Hotel teams evaluating similar offers can track purchases, confirmed bookings, actual usage and refunds separately, and check room availability on popular dates. Use the same observation window across cohorts to compare redemptions.

items.followup_en: The November 13 edition covered the overall platform estimate. Fliggy's disclosure preceded that edition and adds a travel-package fulfilment measure.

items.title: TME live把BIGBANG香港演唱會延伸至山頂及市區
items.summary: TME live公布BIGBANG香港站的場外活動，讓樂迷在山頂廣場及市內地標接觸周年內容。
highlights: 山頂廣場設周年紀念空間，市內設免費打卡點。
主辦方另計劃以媒體藝術和互動體驗延續活動。
items.why: 旅遊零售及場地團隊可分開設計免費參與、到店兌換及付費體驗。
items.next_step: 與合作場地統一活動地圖、兌換條件和各點的參與統計。
items.detail: TME稱與YG Entertainment及合作方把COSMOS主題帶出場館，在山頂廣場設周年紀念空間，並在市內地標設屏幕和打卡點。主辦方亦計劃推出沉浸式媒體展覽，延長演唱會以外的互動。合作商戶可按場地逐一標明參與條件，並分開統計到訪和兌換。
items.title_en: TME live extends BIGBANG's Hong Kong concert to the Peak and city landmarks
items.summary_en: TME live announced offsite events that bring anniversary experiences to the Peak Galleria and landmarks across Hong Kong.
highlights_en: The Peak Galleria hosts an anniversary space, with free photo spots around the city.
Organisers also plan a media art exhibition with interactive experiences.
items.why_en: Travel retail and venue teams can design free participation, store redemption and paid experiences as separate steps.
items.next_step_en: Agree on a shared event map, redemption terms and participation metrics with venue partners.
items.detail_en: TME says it worked with YG Entertainment and partners to extend COSMOS beyond the concert venue, with an anniversary space at the Peak Galleria and screens and photo spots at city landmarks. Organisers also plan an immersive media exhibition to extend participation. Retail partners can state terms by location and track visits separately from redemptions.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Iterable公布託管連接器，讓行銷團隊在AI工具籌備活動
items.summary: Iterable開放託管連接器試用，支援在Claude、ChatGPT及Cursor籌備行銷流程。
highlights: 行銷人員用自己的Iterable帳戶登入，沿用既有角色權限。
試用須向Iterable客戶經理查詢。
items.why: 客戶關係管理團隊可先評估活動草擬和審批能否沿用現有分工。
items.next_step: 用唯讀權限試查一項活動，確認哪些職位可查看資料或改動流程。
items.detail: Iterable透過模型情境協定（MCP）把平台接到三款AI工具。公告描述可由構思走到待上線的行銷流程，操作受登入者的角色權限約束。官方社群資料列明現階段提供試用，團隊可向客戶經理確認細節。安排試用時，可先用不涉及個人資料的活動範本，記錄哪些操作需要人工批准。
items.title_en: Iterable introduces a hosted connector for planning campaigns in AI tools
items.summary_en: Iterable opened a trial of a hosted connector for campaign workflows in Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor.
highlights_en: Marketers sign in with their own Iterable accounts and keep their existing role permissions.
Contact an Iterable account representative about the trial.
items.why_en: CRM teams can assess whether campaign drafting and approvals fit their current roles.
items.next_step_en: Check one campaign with read-only access and identify who can view data or change workflows.
items.detail_en: Iterable connects its platform to three AI tools via Model Context Protocol, or MCP. It describes a workflow from an idea to a launch-ready journey, subject to the signed-in user's role. The community FAQ says access is in trial through account representatives. Start with a template that contains no personal data and document which actions need human approval.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Basis擴展Compass，把媒體研究和投放紀錄帶進規劃
items.summary: Basis公布Compass新增第三方研究接入和跨渠道表現分析，亦開放部分功能供外部AI代理操作。
highlights: 研究接入首批支援Morning Consult，須使用客戶本身的憑證。
支援的外部代理可讀寫部分策略、規劃及投放功能。
items.why: 媒體團隊可把規劃參考資料集中整理，並把查詢與改動投放的權限分開。
items.next_step: 先用歷史活動做唯讀測試，逐項核對來源、轉換定義及可操作的帳戶範圍。
items.detail: Basis表示，Compass可把品牌以往的跨渠道表現帶入新計劃，並接入客戶已訂用的Morning Consult研究。Basis另透過模型情境協定（MCP）向外部AI工具提供部分讀寫功能。評估時可先核對歷史數據的歸因口徑，再決定哪些操作可以交給代理，哪些必須由人員批准。
items.title_en: Basis expands Compass to bring media research and campaign history into planning
items.summary_en: Basis announced third-party research and cross-channel performance capabilities in Compass, plus external AI agent access to selected features.
highlights_en: Morning Consult is an initial research partner, using customer credentials.
Supported external agents can read and write selected strategy, planning and activation features.
items.why_en: Media teams can consolidate planning inputs and separate lookup permissions from campaign changes.
items.next_step_en: Run a read-only test on a past campaign and check sources, conversion definitions and account scope.
items.detail_en: Basis says Compass can bring prior cross-channel performance into planning and connect to a customer's Morning Consult research. A Model Context Protocol, or MCP, server also gives external AI tools read and write access to selected features. Check the attribution basis of historical data before deciding which actions to delegate and which require human approval.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: DomoAI推出InkoAI Agent，影片可逐步審稿
items.summary: DomoAI表示，InkoAI Agent可在同一對話管理短片的劇本、角色及鏡頭，並在生成前請創作者確認。
highlights: 現有流程包括短劇、動畫和一般故事。
從商品連結或相片製作影片廣告仍屬計劃。
items.why: 社交內容團隊可在進入後期前，分別核對劇本、角色和鏡頭的品牌要求。
items.next_step: 用已授權素材試做一段短片，逐步記錄審稿、修改和輸出的工序。
items.detail: DomoAI公布InkoAI Agent已可使用，並列出短劇、動畫及一般故事等製作流程。創作者可在同一對話提供文字、圖片或其他參考素材，並審批劇本、角色與鏡頭。公司把商品連結或相片直接生成影片廣告列為後續計劃。測試時宜先確認素材授權和品牌審批安排。
items.title_en: DomoAI launches InkoAI Agent with staged video approvals
items.summary_en: DomoAI says InkoAI Agent can manage scripts, characters and shots in one conversation and seek creator approval before generating.
highlights_en: Current workflows include short drama, animation and general storytelling.
Video ad generation from a product link or photo is still planned.
items.why_en: Social teams can check brand requirements for scripts, characters and shots before post-production.
items.next_step_en: Try one short clip with cleared assets and track review, revision and export steps.
items.detail_en: DomoAI announced that InkoAI Agent is available with workflows for short drama, animation and general stories. Creators can supply text, images and other reference material in the same conversation and approve scripts, characters and shots. The company lists video ads from product links or photos as a future workflow. Confirm asset rights and brand approvals before testing.

items.title: New Engen公布內部AI工具Bakery，把投放數據接入創意簡報
items.summary: New Engen披露旗下創意團隊已使用Bakery，參考過往廣告表現來構思、寫簡報及起草腳本。
highlights: 團隊可搜尋過往表現較佳的創意概念。
從簡報生成選角需求仍屬計劃。
items.why: 媒體與創意團隊可先統一素材和投放數據的標籤，讓下一輪簡報有可追溯依據。
items.next_step: 挑一個產品，將歷來素材按受眾、訴求和版型標記，再試寫兩份不同方向的簡報。
items.detail: Bakery由New Engen旗下Donut Studios開發，已用於代理商內部製作。公司描述的流程是先找過往創意概念，再把投放表現帶進構思和簡報，最後在同一環境草擬腳本。公告未列明對外開放安排。品牌可先保存每個概念的投放條件，以免把不同受眾或版位的結果直接並列。
items.title_en: New Engen unveils internal AI tool Bakery to bring ad data into creative briefs
items.summary_en: New Engen says its creative team uses Bakery to bring past ad results into ideation, briefing and scripting.
highlights_en: Teams can search previously high-performing creative concepts.
Generating casting requests from briefs is still planned.
items.why_en: Media and creative teams can align asset and performance tags so the next brief has traceable evidence.
items.next_step_en: Choose one product, tag previous ads by audience, message and format, then draft two distinct briefs.
items.detail_en: Bakery was built within New Engen's Donut Studios and is used in its own production. The agency describes finding past concepts, bringing campaign performance into ideation and briefing, and drafting scripts in the same environment. External availability was not specified. Brands can record campaign conditions before comparing results across audiences or placements.

items.title: Cision開放Brandwatch消費研究的AI接入
items.summary: Cision推出Cision Intelligence，首階段讓客戶經模型情境協定（MCP）在支援工具查詢Brandwatch消費研究資料。
highlights: 首版提供查詢管理、快速搜尋、摘要及提示。
其他產品與搜尋情報的整合仍屬計劃。
items.why: 公關團隊可比較日常AI工具與原有研究平台的查詢結果和資料範圍。
items.next_step: 取一條品牌監測查詢，比對結果的時間窗、樣本來源及摘要是否保留原意。
items.detail: Cision表示，首階段會透過Cision MCP連接Brandwatch Consumer Research的代理，讓客戶在支援工具中建立查詢、探索消費者討論、整理摘要及設定提示。接入是現有Brandwatch研究流程的另一個入口。使用摘要製作簡報前，可抽查原始討論和查詢條件。
items.title_en: Cision opens an AI connector to Brandwatch consumer research
items.summary_en: Cision launched Cision Intelligence, initially connecting Brandwatch Consumer Research to supported tools via Model Context Protocol, or MCP.
highlights_en: The first release supports query management, quick search, summaries and alerts.
Connections to search intelligence and other products remain planned.
items.why_en: PR teams can compare query results and data coverage between their AI tools and the research platform.
items.next_step_en: Compare one brand-monitoring query for time window, data sources and fidelity of the summary.
items.detail_en: Cision says its first release connects Brandwatch Consumer Research agents through Cision MCP. In supported tools, customers can build queries, explore consumer conversations, generate summaries and configure alerts. It provides another entry point to the existing research workflow. Check the original conversations and query settings before using summaries in a brief.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 新加坡UNIQLO聯乘吉卜力，串連展覽集印與門店換領
items.summary: UNIQLO新加坡公布與吉卜力工作室合作的新UT系列。據Marketing-Interactive報道，當地安排優先發售和展覽集印。
highlights: 系列圖案取材自吉卜力作品、插畫及展覽海報等。
按當地計劃，參觀者可在展覽集印，再到指定分店換領徽章。
items.why: 品牌可用跨場地兌換連接展覽參與與門店到訪，並分開記錄兩個環節。
items.next_step: 策劃聯乘時先定好集印位置、兌換分店和數量，再用同一識別碼追蹤。
items.detail: UNIQLO新加坡的官方系列頁列出吉卜力作品、照片、插畫及海報等視覺素材。Marketing-Interactive報道，當地計劃在Orchard Central旗艦店舉辦優先發售，並與Gardens by the Bay的展覽合作，安排參觀者集印後到指定UNIQLO門店換領徽章。
items.title_en: UNIQLO Singapore ties Studio Ghibli exhibition stamps to store redemption
items.summary_en: UNIQLO Singapore announced a Studio Ghibli UT collection. Marketing-Interactive reported local plans for an advance sale and an exhibition stamp rally.
highlights_en: The designs draw on Studio Ghibli works, illustrations and exhibition posters.
The Singapore plan links exhibition stamps to pin redemption at participating stores.
items.why_en: Brands can connect exhibition visits and store traffic with redemption and measure each step separately.
items.next_step_en: Set stamp locations, redemption stores and quantities before a collaboration, then track the steps with a shared identifier.
items.detail_en: UNIQLO Singapore's collection page lists Studio Ghibli works, photos, illustrations and posters as visual sources. Marketing-Interactive reported plans for an advance sale at the Orchard Central flagship and a partnership with an exhibition at Gardens by the Bay. Visitors would collect stamps at the exhibition before redeeming a pin at participating UNIQLO stores.
